title: Byzantine-Islamic Frontier Database Schema v3
description: Schema v3 realises the committed logical_model.md (Step-3a plan). It introduces the spatial supertable + spatial_type discriminator, polymorphic (type,id) references with NO distinctness constraint, a generic geometry column with a four-type CHECK, designated-pointer nullable FKs, and the phasing_scheme discriminator with I6 keyed on (subject, phasing_scheme). v3 COEXISTS with v1/v2 records until the migration passes move data; nothing here migrates a record. Where a physical realisation detail would require reopening a logical-model decision, it is FLAGGED in $comment, not decided.

SpatialType.$comment: The discriminator over the spatial supertable. MUTABLE — a re-typing is a column update, never an ID re-issue (logical_model.md §0.5). The identifier stays opaque (ENT-PLC- space).

GeometryType.$comment: The four-type CHECK. No GEOMETRYCOLLECTION, no curved types (logical_model.md §2.4, Step-3a plan §3.1).

ReferenceMode.$comment: QualifiedSubjectLink.reference_mode (item 5). candidate does NOT enter the Assertion dedup key (§2.3a); definite/collective do.

PolymorphicRef.$comment: The polymorphic (type,id) reference used by relationship endpoints and QualifiedSubjectLink. NO distinctness constraint — same-type pairs (e.g. Component->Component succeeds, Demand-B) are admitted. The plan forbids a CHECK(source_type != target_type).

DomainRef.$comment: QualifiedSubjectLink.subject ranges over DOMAIN entities only (L-poly). No typed per-subject columns anywhere — the single polymorphic ref is the only subject reference (logical_model.md §8).

geometry.$comment: WKT/GeoJSON, EPSG:4326. One generic column; the four-type CHECK is geometry_type.

phasing_scheme.$comment: item-13 discriminator. I6 non-overlap keyed (subject, phasing_scheme), NOT (subject). Defaulting to 'default' leaves today's single-phasing corpus untouched.

oneOf.title: SpatialThing (supertable + spatial_type)

designated_spatial_assertion.$comment: NULLABLE nullable FK (item 8: a Site may have zero geometry). Single-valued => I11 structural.

oneOf.$comment: overall_confidence is ABSENT by design (retired M3). A stored overall_confidence is a v3 violation.

parent_site.$comment: dependency; cascade delete (I13). Identity = fabric, not footprint.

supporting_attestations.$comment: I3/I4: >=1. The subject set is DERIVED from these (a view), never stored (§2.3a).

oneOf.title: Attestation
oneOf.$comment: I2: paraphrase OR direct_quotation non-empty. Subject links are QualifiedSubjectLink rows (below), not a field here.

attestation.$comment: plain FK; subject links are attestation-side only (§2.3a).

supporting_evidence.$comment: I5: non-empty, ATT- only (rule 9). This is the field the M6 rule-9 back-fill populates.

oneOf.title: Relationship

rel_type.$comment: checked against the ratified vocabulary TTL by the relationship-vocabulary validator — NOT an enum here, so the schema does not duplicate the vocabulary (single source of truth = the TTL).

oneOf.$comment: NO distinctness constraint on (source_entity, target_entity) types — same-type pairs admitted (Demand-B).

$comment_flags: Realisation details that would require reopening a logical-model decision are FLAGGED, not decided: (1) relationship referential integrity over a union of tables has no single JSON-Schema/DB FK mechanism — the validator enforces it (Step-3a plan §6, flagged reading 1); this schema deliberately does NOT add a distinctness or per-type FK constraint. (2) The Assertion subject-set is a derived view, not a stored column; the schema does not add a subject column to Assertion (§2.3a, flagged reading 2). Neither is settled here.
